title: Missouri Bigfoot Sighting Followed by Strange Radiation Spike
excerpt: A researcher in Missouri picked up a strange spike in radiation levels near where Bigfoot activity had been reported.
content:
Safe to say that any sighting of an unknown creature in Missouri is odd, but a recent one takes the cake. A researcher reported activity that resembled a Bigfoot-like creature that included a strange spike in radiation levels. Oh, and it happened during a lunar eclipse, too.

This is a new investigation of Bigfoot activity in Missouri from the YouTube Channel Sasquatch Theory

I would recommend watching the video as he explains the findings much better than I can, but the research was done using audio recorders, nighttime cameras with night vision and he even took a radiation detector with him. It's right around the 54 minute mark of the video where he explains that when there was Bigfoot activity near their cabin, he picked up a spike in radiation levels also.

He also noted that they had been leaving apples out in locations that would not be accessible to other wildlife and those apples started disappearing. During the investigation, they heard odd vocalizations by a creature that didn't sound like a coyote or bear. There was also a strange white image that was spotted in the wooded area where they were staying. It was almost like someone or something was monitoring their investigation.

If you're interested in this type of content, I highly recommend following Sasquatch Theory on YouTube as he frequently does on-location investigations in Missouri where strange activity is being reported.
